description: The chart illustrates average performance values for three category settings labeled along the horizontal axis, with stacked bars separating two components identified in the legend as “Standard” (gray) and “Ours” (blue). The x-axis contains the categories “Base,” “CORG,” and a third unlabeled tick at the right (shown with a small gray label box but no readable text), arranged left to right; no x-axis title is shown. The vertical axis is labeled “Average Performance” and uses a linear scale ranging from 48 to 62, with evenly spaced tick marks every 2 units and dashed horizontal gridlines. Each category is represented by a single stacked bar: for “Base,” the bar is entirely blue (no visible gray segment) reaching just under 60 (approximately 59.2); for “CORG,” a gray lower segment rises to about 51.5 with a blue segment stacked above it to a total just under 60 (approximately 59.5); for the rightmost unlabeled category, the gray segment reaches about 53.4 with a blue segment stacked above to a total slightly above 60 (approximately 60.1). The bars are not explicitly sorted by value, and there are no additional annotations or visual emphasis beyond the color coding and stacking.
